changelog: Smarter recall and a reliability view. When your notes agree about something, DensAssistant now answers from a tight, consistent set (faster, less chance of grabbing a stray note); when your captures disagree, it keeps the fuller picture and flags 'notes vary'. A new Reliability trend panel in Settings charts how well your recent answers were backed by your own memory, with a marker whenever a weakly-grounded answer was double-checked by the cloud.
